name: glimmerglass
description: Make your transparent animation play with real transparency on any website.

interface.longDescription: Make your transparent animation play on a website. Bring an animated WebP, GIF, APNG, MOV, MP4 or WebM with transparency. Glimmerglass converts it into one .glim file that plays in Safari, Chrome, Edge and Firefox, shows it in the chat over a background you choose, and gives you the file, a poster and the code to paste. Try the sample animations right away. Converting your own files needs a Glimmerglass license. Glimmerglass does not create animation or remove backgrounds.
capabilities: Explain transparent video on the web
defaultPrompt: Why does my transparent animation show a black box in Safari?
Show me an example of a transparent animation playing.
Get my transparent animation ready for my website.

positive.prompt: How do I get my transparent animation to work on my website?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains which video format each browser needs and what goes wrong otherwise, says what Glimmerglass can do, and offers to convert the user's file.

positive.prompt: Show me an example of a transparent animation playing.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the player with a sample animation playing with real transparency, and its Playback settings beside it. No sign-in is needed.

positive.prompt: Get this transparent animation ready for my website.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to sign in if they have not, converts the attached animated WebP, plays the result in the player, and gives links to the .glim and poster plus the embed code.

positive.prompt: Show the airship sample so it only plays when I hover over it, on a black background.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the player with Play set to On hover and the black background. The animation plays only while the pointer is over it.

positive.prompt: Give me the file and embed code for the sword sample at half speed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a download link for the .glim with speed 0.5 saved in it, its poster, and HTML to paste into a page.

negative.prompt: How do I remove the background from a photo of my dog?
Make me an animation of a dancing cat.
How do I embed a YouTube video on my website?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Converting requires signing in with an existing Glimmerglass license, purchased outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: A shorter description. Nothing else has changed.
